meta.name: Mohomaya
meta.description:
Rishi comes to live as a paying guest in his childhood friend Miki's house. Rishi soon forms a bond with Aruna who he starts seeing as his mother. But Rishi's obsession eventually pushes him towards a past he always wanted to escape from.

Returning Series · First aired 26 Mar 2021 · India · Language: Bengali

Not complete. On your server: S1 5/5 | S2 1/5 (missing E2-5)

On your server — Audio: Bengali (from file names)

videos.title: Toe ring
videos.overview: As Miki leaves for Canada, he requests Aruna to accommodate Rishi, his childhood friend, as a paying guest. Although hesitant at first, Aruna agrees after meeting Rishi, impressed by his respectable behaviour.

videos.title: Bhogoban kotha sone na
videos.overview: Rishi becomes an inseparable part of Aruna's household. Rishi's past is a deep ocean of secrets, and he finds a motherly solace in Aruna.

videos.title: Jhumjhumi
videos.overview: Aruna's husband Suranjan becomes wary of this unconventional bond between Aruna and Rishi. Strange accidents start to happen in the household, putting Mithi at stake.

videos.title: Mrito Jonaki
videos.overview: Faced with questions, Rishi decides to leave Suranjan's house. But Aruna's growing dependency on him doesn't let him leave. Miki's girlfriend Baishali visits Suranjan, and devises a ploy to find out more about Rishi.

videos.title: Achin Pakhi
videos.overview: Rishi takes over the household. Suranjan becomes even more doubtful about Rishi's motive, but Aruna has blind faith in Rishi. On the other hand, Baishali finds out about Rishi's obsessive fixation with his mother Maya.

videos.title: Nirbak
videos.overview: Aruna finds solace in Rishi despite Suranjan’s apprehension. What fate awaits Baishali as she tries to uncover Rishi’s truth?
